description: Clean-room read-only Wave 6D-4 probes confirming NVForever parity across xNVSE core, JIP unlisted, JohnnyGuitar, ShowOff, SUP, AnhNVSE, and kNVSE.

batches.title: Wave 6D-4: Confirmed-match [observed] promotions (xNVSE, JIP, JG, ShowOff, SUP, Anh, kNVSE)

probes.claim: SD-10: Verify xNVSE ammo queries (with 10mm Pistol + Ammo10mm vs Ammo556mm vs AmmoList10mm), BuildRef invalid modIndex/localID returns, and GetLocalRefIndex on base vs placed vs 0xFF refs.
probes.expected: Check exact boolean/ref returns for ammo list membership, BuildRef out-of-range mod indices (255, -1), and GetLocalRefIndex on base vs dynamic refs.
script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w6d4_05_ammo_queries_and_buildref_localidx|ammo(%g,%g,has=%g,eq=%g/%g,lst=%g/%g,cur=%g)|build(ok=%g,255=%i,neg=%i,miss=%i)|loc(%g,%g,%g)" can10 can556 hasA eqCan10 eqCan556 inList usesList curOk bMatch b255 bNeg bMiss liBase liDoc liTmp

probes.claim: Verify GetWeaponCanUseAmmo on weapon inv-ref and equipped ammo queries after 3-tick equip settle.
probes.expected: Confirm exact 1/0 returns for 10mm Pistol + Ammo10mm vs Ammo556mm and AmmoList10mm.

probes.expected: NVForever returns a script error on nonexistent/non-string GMST in SetStringSetting; check whether original returns 0 cleanly.

probes.expected: Check exact ToString outputs for numeric maps and ar_Null (`ext-last-core.md` §4) and non-locus GetUIFloatInherited behavior.
